directive: Campaign is foundation; Elite is mastery; Endgame provides Ascension, async Arena, Trials, Raids, Faction Mastery, Seasons, Events, Achievements, Cosmetics, and fair monetization hooks.

directorReview.decision: one-active-deity deity is now the standard for Campaign, Elite, Ascension, Arena, Trials, Raids, and Events.
No Canon rewrite. Seven-faction Canon remains authoritative over six-faction planning math.
2D tactical Titans and 3D elongated tactical maps remain locked for endgame.
Endgame systems are modular registries; live PvP is explicitly reserved as a future control layer.

canonNotice: Current Canon/Codex registers seven factions. Endgame architecture supports all seven and remains expandable; the six-faction 240-mission target is retained only as a directive planning benchmark.
